reviewer: separate AI collaborator; author of D design/models, not author of reviewed controller/I/O

checks.basis: authority() enforces branch, exact typed authority, author attachment hash and C PASS/CLOSED_CONSUMED/TEST_CONSUMED; no historical authority is reactivated.

preflight reads allowed textual files and Git, verifies direct method-commit parent, historical preservation, installed pins, frozen bytes/hash/Git blobs and current model/budget/row contracts. It constructs no reader or receipt.

read_text has a dedicated C filename allowlist excluding results and DEV/TEST prediction/metric bundles; data paths are denied. Split membership metadata is permitted solely for exclusion and custody.
verify_ci requires exact method SHA, ten unique named jobs, completed success for runs/jobs/all steps; skipped/pending/duplicate/missing evidence fails.
EXECUTION_RECEIPT is written with O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW and file/directory fsync before construction or load of the reader. Existing receipt/results/terminal prevent another attempt.

validate_inputs compares original rows by type/value/order; preflight also compares design rows to original C TRAIN GOLD/BACKGROUND rows. TrainAccessState grants once only for the exact complete storage-enriched manifest and receipt/head binding.

validate_rows admits only exact TRAIN positive/GOLD or background/BACKGROUND identities and the two constant containers; checks offsets, row bounds, shape/dtype, three hashes, positive row provenance and no duplicate physical row before opening paths.

I/O uses exact 8450-byte os.pread ranges only; no MP4/ESM source, decoder, whole-file hash, mmap or TEST cache path is available. Shared TRAIN/DEV container opening authorizes only manifest TRAIN ranges.

Each complete row is authenticated against pair and two modality hashes before array assignment. Containers are opened once per path; fstat fingerprints checked at start/end; all descriptors close on normal completion or access exception.

Controller materializes and authenticates all 10907 TRAIN rows, checks zero firewall counters, calls frozen extract_lbp20 once, retains TRAIN features in memory and then closes/discards input pairs; no feature cache or RF is persisted.

RF_FIT_START and RF_FIT_COMPLETE callbacks advance started/completed counters separately; prediction/scoring have later counters. A completed fit is retained in counts even if prediction fails; no retry path exists.

Controller traverses only the frozen schedule, refuses duplicates/101st start, requires 84+12+4 completed fits and 100 validations, and obtains eight reference-only reuses from the frozen summaries without calling another learner.

Model sees supplied training indices only; predictions accept no labels; held-out rows remain original TRAIN historical-CV groups. Original C metric_bundle is used. Summary must expose seven preregistered fields and nine-condition table; no DEV/TEST/model selection branch exists.
Final controller now copies measured firewall counters from audit when present. The existing simulated violation test asserts terminal DEV_ROWS_READ=1 instead of falsely replacing it by zero.

findings.initial_issue: The initial terminal constructor reported fixed zero firewall counters even after an audit mismatch stopped execution; the synthetic firewall fixture supplied DEV_ROWS_READ=1.
findings.resolution: Root added terminal counter update from audit.get(key, 0), and extended the existing failure test to require DEV_ROWS_READ=1. Reviewed the resulting source and assertion statically; no test or fit was rerun by this reviewer.

this_review.auxiliary_occurrence: One read-only request used nonexistent scripts/run_study2d_attribution.py; corrected to scripts/run_study2d.py without running either path.

limits: Static review establishes control-flow compatibility only; it is not proof of remote CI, a committed freeze or a successful scientific execution.
Actual frozen group/ranking/quantile plan verification is the separate parent stdlib audit; this review neither rebuilt nor reranked the real plan.
Canonical background row locators/hashes depend on the separately authenticated TRAIN_INPUT_MANIFEST and integration custody; this review did not read its original cache index or any payload.
Counters cover application-level opens and directed pread ranges, not universal syscall tracing or kernel page cache activity.
Historical split manifests contain documentary DEV/TEST membership; reading that text is distinct from materializing their group payloads or predictions.
Interrupted evidence writes can leave a consumed receipt with incomplete terminal output; the existing receipt still forbids a scientific retry.
The reviewed synthetic fixtures are mocked control-flow evidence. This reviewer did not independently rerun them during this static review.
